result.document_summary: A mid-document chunk of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 2, Government) covering construction-manager subcontractor listing, the Responsible Banking Ordinance, and the Special Events Ordinance, with no rental housing rules.
result.notes: This part contains no rules in the six rental-housing categories. The page URL points to San Diego's algorithmic rent-setting ban (Div. 11, § 98.1103), but the text in this chunk is only Chapter 2 Administrative Code material (§§ 22.3811-22.4005: subcontractor listing, false declarations, banking community reinvestment, special event permits). No algorithmic rent-setting text appears here, so no record was extracted; the relevant text may be in another part.
